description: If a finite problem has a unifier into any target variable alphabet, the initialized solver returns a substitution.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify_complete.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L)
  (σ : ℕ → L.Term α) (hσ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ P) :
  ∃ μ, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify P = some μ
